task: Evaluate computational power of random quantum circuit sampling (RCS) on arbitrary geometries
methods: Exponential decay model fitting for error rate extraction
Per-qubit and per-cycle error rate estimation
comparison_axes: Depth scan at fixed N (N=40, N=56)
Qubit count scan at fixed depth (d=12)
Cross-method validation (XEB vs MB vs Transport)
key_outputs: XEB fidelity with uncertainty per (N, d, r)
MB probability with uncertainty per (N, d, r)
